newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 720 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 720 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 720 contracts versus 3,271 contracts overnight Sunday.
There were 56 wheat, 209 corn, 410 soybean, 27 soymeal, 14 soyoil and four oat futures contracts traded, along with 13 soybean calls and one soybean put.

Corn was unchanged to 1/2 cent higher, wheat unchanged to two cents higher, soybeans one to 2-1/2 cents higher, soyoil unchanged to 0.07 cent per lb higher, soymeal $0.70 per ton higher and oats unchanged to 4-1/4 cents higher.
